data.name: Alim
data.gender_notes: Alim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Learned, Scholar, One who has knowledge
data.long_meaning: Alim is a prestigious Arabic name meaning 'one who has knowledge' or 'scholar'. It is derived from the root word 'ilm' (knowledge) and refers to a person deeply learned in religion, law, or truth. The name Alim carries the meaning “Learned, Scholar, One who has knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Alim usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, scholar, one who has knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents a person blessed with divine knowledge and wisdom, acting as a guide and light for others.
data.etymology: Alim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Learned, Scholar, One who has knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عليم
in_arabic.meaning: الله کا نام، بہت بڑا عالم، سب کچھ جاننے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: عليم اللہ کے 99 ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سب کچھ جاننے والا، بہت بڑا عالم۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام ذاتی طور پر اللہ کی صفت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جو ہر چیز کو جانتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: علیم
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کا نام، بہت بڑا عالم، سب کچھ جاننے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیم ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اللہ کی قدرت اور علم کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں یہ نام بہت مقبول ہے اور اکثر بچوں کو یہ نام دیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलीम
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान का नाम, बहुत बड़ा ज्ञानी, सब कुछ जानने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीम एक ऐसा नाम है जो भगवान की ज्ञान और शक्ति को प्रकट करता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और कुरआन में उल्लेख किया गया है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम बहुत लोकप्रिय है और अक्सर बच्चों को यह नाम दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عليم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عليم د الله تعالیٰ یو نوم دی چې معنی یې ده هر څه پوهیږي. دا نوم د قرآن کریم په شان د پښتنو په مذهبي دود کې ډیر اهمیت لري. دا نوم د الله تعالیٰ د علم او حکمت څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Alim
in_english.meaning: All-knowing, Omniscient, One who knows everything
in_english.long_meaning: Alim is one of the 99 names of Allah in Islam, derived from the Arabic root 'علم' which means 'to know'. This name signifies the attribute of Allah who is all-knowing and omniscient. It is mentioned in the Quran and holds significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing wisdom, knowledge, and divine understanding.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ: عَليم

data.cultural_impact: The name Alim is deeply rooted in Islamic culture, and its societal significance is that of a respected and honorable individual. In the Muslim world, there is a strong emphasis on knowledge acquisition, and the Alim embodies the ultimate attainment of this ideal. They are looked up to as leaders in their communities and trusted sources of wisdom and guidance based on their deep understanding of Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Alim holds deep meaning. Islam values knowledge and wisdom, as they are considered the keys to understanding God's will and connecting more closely to Him. The Alim's quest for knowledge reflects their dedication to delving deeper into their faith, seeking to better understand God and His teachings. As a result, the Alim is regarded as a spiritual guide, a bridge between the divine and the human world. Overall, the name Alim encapsulates the ideal of a learned and pious Muslim, upholding the importance of knowledge and spiritual growth in the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_symbolism: An 'Alim' in Islamic tradition is a scholar well-versed in Islamic law and theology. The name signifies a deep understanding and dedication to knowledge, with a commitment to apply this wisdom for the betterment of the self and the community.

islamic_reference.note: Cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), fourth Caliph

historical_references.reference: Alim ibn Zaid Al-Hilali (d. 728 AD) was a prominent scholar and teacher in the early Islamic period.
historical_references.context: Alim was a scholar and teacher in the early Islamic period.
